id.description: Stable across passes; the decision store keys on it.

severity.description: Consequence if unfixed, not confidence that it is wrong.

target.description: Which pass target produced it, e.g. 'citation framing', 'numeric consistency'.

anchor.description: Verbatim phrase from the paragraph this concerns; resolved to a line at build. Preferred over 'line'.

line.description: 1-based line in the source; fallback when no anchor is given.

grounding.description: ran=executed and observed; read=opened the source; fetched=retrieved the cited external work; retrieved=from our own prior record (testimony, not observation); assumed=not checked.

title.description: One line: the claim, not the rationale.

issue.description: What is wrong, stated so the author can check it.

evidence.description: The command, URL, or file:line — what was actually done.

edit.description: Proposed replacement text, or the decision to be made.

artifact.description: Optional id of the record holding this finding in a knowledge graph (Empirica tier).
